product_one_liner.value: Neostella provides a connected enterprise case-management platform that unifies data, workflows, communications, integrations and AI for law firms and high-volume legal teams.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is product and legal-operations thought leadership; no qualifying series of engineer-authored implementation posts was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No qualifying title was found among the readable current listings. The historical Machine Learning Engineer posting explicitly says it was removed on February 17, 2026; the main job board is dynamically rendered, limiting verification of completeness.

model_provider.notes: The AI product page, MCP documentation, blog, privacy policy and available legal materials did not identify the provider powering built-in AI. Claude and ChatGPT are documented external MCP clients, not established embedded-model providers. The referenced trust/subprocessor pages were not retrievable.

last_funding.notes: The database dates the round June 5, 2025. The June 6 Form D reports first sale May 23, 2025 and $10.7 million sold; the offering includes conversion/cancellation of convertible instruments. No named series is established.

raised_18mo.notes: First sale May 23, 2025 falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: June 2026 release notes explicitly announce Global Objects — Full Launch, centralized operational records shared across projects and workflows.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Drew Stern’s profile dates his Chief Operating Officer tenure at Neostella April 2025–March 2026, establishing a departure within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The administrator posting explicitly describes the company’s mature Salesforce instance; the current Account Executive posting also names Salesforce. The administrator job is historical, not a current opening. Generic alternative-platform experience requirements were not treated as confirmed usage.
